registry_snapshot.fingerprint_algorithm: sha256(recursively key-sorted compact UTF-8 JSON of each complete raw registry source object); preserve array order; do not add derived fields before hashing
registry_snapshot.collection_id_rule: Preserve explicit registry collection_id; otherwise resolve to id, as web_catalog.py:634 does. registry_collection_id remains null if absent.

scope.selection: Bounded purposive sample: 12 Musashino municipal elementary schools plus six existing registry schools across four Tokyo wards, elementary/middle/metropolitan high.

status_contract.semantics: Verification dimensions are independent. Reachable HTML index is not proof that any linked PDF is readable. Directory identity verification does not verify endpoint reachability. Unverified means not established, not absent. Null dates mean no check for that dimension; dates of fetched parent pages are not copied to unvisited child endpoints.

municipality.recommendation: Store as strings with version/effective dates; distinguish five-digit regional code from six-digit local-government code. Geographic municipality differs from school operator, notably Aoyama.

limitations: Only registry endpoints explicitly marked reachable were checked; other bodies are unverified despite directory or collection relationships.

Search/open tool returned cached older versions and some 403 responses; bounded unauthenticated direct HTTPS requests succeeded. Direct observations take precedence; a tool-specific 403 is not evidence of an authenticated guardian boundary.
Honjuku HTML has image-labelled PDF links; body readability and issue/grade extraction remain unverified.
Only Sakurano October grade PDF and Sekimaeminami August/September school PDF were sampled. All Asobee PDF bodies remain unverified.
Public link discovery does not verify commercial republication rights. School footers include reproduction restrictions.
Research does not test application ingestion, notification delivery, translation, OCR, production UI or deployed completeness.

recommendations.text: Use independent identity, transport, index readability, document readability and audience fields; never turn school existence into a coverage claim.
Distinguish school notices, municipal administration, Gakudo facility/admissions material and provider Asobee newsletters, even inside one collection.
Treat school level, specific grade, admission cohort, programme membership and document purpose as separate targeting evidence.
Retain source dates and observed dates separately; verify body dates before treating a grade index or filename as current-year evidence.
